note: The backend now refuses to start without STREAM_URL_SECRET, which the server's .env does not have, so web crash-loops right after the deploy started and Caddy answers 502.

cause.title: feat: sign stream urls with their own secret
cause.author: Philipp Klinger
cause.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/ci.yml b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -70,6 +70,7 @@ jobs:
       DB_HOST: localhost
       DB_PASSWORD: videoflix
       SECRET_KEY: ci-only-secret
+      STREAM_URL_SECRET: ci-only-stream-secret
       REDIS_HOST: localhost
 
     steps:
diff --git a/core/settings.py b/core/settings.py
@@ -21,6 +21,12 @@ SECRET_KEY = os.getenv("SECRET_KEY")
 if not SECRET_KEY:
     raise RuntimeError("SECRET_KEY must be set via environment variable")
 
+# Signs HLS segment URLs (video_app.api.views); separate from SECRET_KEY on purpose.
+STREAM_URL_SECRET = os.getenv("STREAM_URL_SECRET")
+if not STREAM_URL_SECRET:
+    raise RuntimeError("STREAM_URL_SECRET must be set via environment variable")
+STREAM_URL_LIFETIME_SECONDS = int(os.getenv("STREAM_URL_LIFETIME_SECONDS", "300"))
+
 DEBUG = env_bool("DEBUG", "False")
 
diff --git a/video_app/api/views.py b/video_app/api/views.py
@@ -217,6 +217,8 @@ class VideoHLSServeView(views.APIView):
     def get(self, request, video_id, resolution, filename):
         video = _get_video_or_404(request.user, video_id)
         video_res = _get_video_resolution_or_404(video, resolution)
+        if not _valid_signature(request, video_id, resolution, filename):
+            raise PermissionDenied("Invalid or expired stream link.")
         base_dir = os.path.dirname(video_res.converted_file.path)
         file_path = _get_hls_file_path(base_dir, filename)
         content_type = _get_content_type(filename)
cause.body:
Segment URLs were only protected by the session cookie. They now carry an HMAC
signature with a short lifetime. The key is a separate secret, so a leaked
SECRET_KEY does not open the streams as well.
